summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing an agreement with Abra Group for the purchase of up to 45 E195-E2 aircraft, including 20 firm orders, 10 purchase options, and 15 purchase rights. The agreement does not specify a price per share or premium, as it is an aircraft purchase order, not a securities transaction. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Deliveries are expected to begin in Q4 2027. This is a routine commercial contract for an aircraft manufacturer and does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
